dedupe_keys.name: operational status of sanitation infrastructure during the 2024 disaster in southern brazil

description: Iporã Possantti and colleagues publish a Porto Alegre record of water-treatment, wastewater-treatment and stormwater-pump status during the May 2024 floods. Zenodo serves a semicolon-delimited CSV and the underlying municipal information-request responses as text under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. Fields identify each facility, whether it was affected and the reported dates of shutdown, partial operation and full restoration. These events can calibrate service-disruption and recovery simulations for urban sanitation infrastructure. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this city-level restoration chronology. The authors state that this first release covers Porto Alegre only. Empty cells mean the municipal response did not report a value, not necessarily that a plant was unaffected. Data were standardised from administrative replies, not continuous telemetry. Neither file was downloaded, and outage durations were not independently calculated.
